answer: Each operator opens one identity by lodging a 90-day refundable bond and publishing a hardware-attested serial that a public registry hashes into a unique pigment record. New accounts stay at zero voting weight until that horizon expires without a duplicate serial. A weekly falcon challenge then demands a live TPM signature over a fresh nonce; a reused or absent proof slashes the bond and bars further identities, so a farm pays superlinear capital and device cost.
